prompt: Challenge C022-CH3: We want to add a water-balance module so farmers can plan irrigation scheduling, but none of our staff understands evapotranspiration modell

content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Soil moisture mapping using data fusion of satellite radar and optical imagery has been demonstrated across the Pannonian region with validation against in-situ sensors and correlation to irrigation scheduling records.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-08411","field":"abstract","quote":"combines Sentinel-1 C-band backscatter with Sentinel-2 surface reflectance to estimate volumetric soil moisture content"}]},{"text":"Crop simulation models can be assimilated with satellite-derived leaf area index data to generate spatially explicit crop water requirement surfaces at parcel resolution, with sensitivity analysis identifying management drivers.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-08419","field":"abstract","quote":"assimilates Sentinel-2 leaf area index retrievals into the APSERNA crop simulation model via an ensemble Kalman filter"}]},{"text":"Cloud-native processing architectures enable near-real-time agricultural monitoring products at continental scale with daily latency suitable for operational advisory services.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-08420","field":"abstract","quote":"cloud-native service across a 200,000 km² domain with end-to-end latency from Sentinel data availability to dashboard update"}]}],"fit":"partial","fitReason":"The researcher's expertise centres on satellite Earth observation, soil moisture retrieval, and crop modelling integration [SYN-PUB-08411, SYN-PUB-08419], but does not directly address the FAO Penman-Monteith evapotranspiration calculation engine, soil water-holding capacity parameterization, or crop coefficient assignment that are core to the challenge's water-balance module."}
